svg.data-weight-note: 55 lb (25 kg) with power supplies and fans installed (guide Table 8)
svg.data-breakout-ports: up to 64 x 400 GbE, 128 x 200 GbE, 256 x 100 GbE, 256 x 40 GbE, 256 x 25 GbE or 256 x 10 GbE (guide, QFX5230-64CD Switch Description)
svg.data-qsfpdd-speeds: 400, 200, 100, 50, 40 GbE, 4 x 25 GbE or 4 x 10 GbE per port (guide, Port Panel overview)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Maximum at 40 C ambient with SR optics at 100 percent load with IMIX traffic; typical at 25 C with DACs at 50 percent load with IMIX traffic, excluding transceivers (guide Table 13)
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating -40 to -72 VDC (guide Table 18)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1, hot-removable and hot-insertable while the second supply is installed
svg.data-fans: four fan modules of two rotors, 7+1 at rotor level; the switch runs 120 seconds without thermal shutdown while one module is replaced
svg.data-airflow-note: AFO is front-to-back (port-to-FRU); AFI is back-to-front (FRU-to-port); no mixing of fans and supplies of different direction
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) for AFO and AFI (guide Table 24)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C for AFO; for AFI the figure is 0 ft (guide Table 24)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400 GbE QSFP-DD optics; 400G-ZR and 400G-ZRM only in ports 33 to 63 (the odd ones of the lower band)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15; ICES-003; BS EN 55032; BS EN 55035; EN 300 386; CISPR 32; CISPR 35; IEC/EN 61000 series (guide, Compliance Statements for EMC Requirements)
svg.data-nebs: designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements of NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (guide Table 24)
